treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Kingdom of Denmark for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1996, as amended 2018)
eif_quote: De bepalingen van Verdrag en Protocol zullen ingevolge artikel 33, eerste lid, van het Verdrag, juncto de preambule tot het Protocol, op 6 maart 1998 in werking treden. De bepalingen vinden ingevolge hetzelfde artikel en lid toepassing voor de belastingjaren en -tijdvakken die aanvangen op of na 1 januari 1999.
source_title: wetten.overheid.nl consolidated text BWBV0001313 (English authentic text, version from 2018-12-31); amending Protocol 2018 Trb. 2018, 61

rates.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 the State of which the company is a resident shall not levy a tax on dividends paid by that company, if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a company which is a resident of the other State and holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends.

However, such dividends may also be taxed in the State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in one of the States and paid to a resident of the other State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the interest.
Royalties arising in one of the States and paid to a resident of the other State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Convention (English only authentic) applies for taxable years and periods beginning on/after 1-1-1999 (Art. 33(1); Trb. 1998, 57). Art. 23a 'Entitlement to Benefits' (PPT) inserted by the amending Protocol of 9-5-2018 (Trb. 2018, 61), in force 31-12-2018 (Trb. 2018, 207); per its Art. XVI it has effect for taxable years and periods beginning, and taxable events occurring, on/after 1 January of the year following EIF -> 2019-01-01. Protocol VI: income from profit-sharing bonds subject to dividend tax in the source State is treated under Art. 10 (15% cap) notwithstanding Art. 11. MLI: not covered (Denmark and NL do not list this treaty; treaties_merged).
